# Phosphor Studio

> A lo-fi visual studio that turns photos into dithered, halftone, and ASCII retro-display art. It runs entirely in the browser — images never leave the device — with CRT atmospheric effects and a curated collection of presets inspired by films, series, and video games.

## About

- Phosphor Studio is a free, client-side web app at https://phosphorstudio.vercel.app/
- Built by Rodrigo Silva (https://rodrigosilva.design)
- Source code: https://github.com/dreegu/phosphor

## What it does

- Converts uploaded photos into retro-display art: ordered/error-diffusion dithering, halftone patterns, and ASCII art
- Applies CRT and atmospheric post-processing effects
- Offers cinematic and poster presets inspired by films, series, and video games
- Exports to PNG and JPEG (full resolution) and SVG (editable text/shapes)
- Shareable looks via compressed URL links; all processing happens locally in the browser
